Jules Park: Need a tiny "bytebrief" AEs can email to security reviewers — one page, 3 bullets TL;DR, a benchmark headline, and a clear next step (request demo).
Rae Morgan: I'll write. Keep tone factual. Which benchmark stat can we lead with?
Ishaan Desai: Use a comparative line: "Dedicated offers the most predictable P95 latency; Private often gives the lowest unit cost when amortized." Avg tokens/test = 135.
Rae Morgan: Draft TL;DR:
- Predictable P95: Dedicated (reserved pools, SLA)
- Lowest amortized unit cost: Private (customer infra + install)
- Fastest eval: Hosted (quick to onboard)
Short AE email snippet ready to paste.
Jules Park: Add a 2-line methodology note and an eval snippet for reproducibility.
Ishaan Desai: Snippet:
```
./run_eval --model redwood-dedicated-v1 --workload chat --seq-min 50 --seq-max 300 --samples 100000
```
NotifyBot: Reminder: upload PDF + gated HTML to /marketing-assets/bytebriefs by 1746127200.
